description: Second-largest moon in the solar system and the only moon with a substantial atmosphere — thicker than Earth's. Below the orange tholin haze sits the only known body besides Earth with stable liquid on its surface: hydrocarbon lakes and seas of methane and ethane in the polar regions, fed by an active methane hydrologic cycle that includes clouds, rain, and rivers carving water-ice bedrock. Huygens (ESA) made the first landing on a moon other than Earth's in 2005. NASA's Dragonfly will arrive in 2034 as a nuclear-powered rotorcraft, hopping between Titan's organic-rich landscapes.
surface_composition: Water-ice bedrock under organic dunes + hydrocarbon lakes (methane / ethane) + a nitrogen-methane atmosphere 1.45× Earth's sea-level pressure. Tholin haze tints the sky orange.
